config.exact: raw UTF-8 source; remove all Unicode whitespace; SHA256
config.near: remove comments outside strings; remove all Unicode whitespace; character SequenceMatcher
limitations: Whitespace normalization also removes whitespace within literal values, as requested; textual identity is not semantic equivalence.
SequenceMatcher ratio is order-dependent; fixed order is recorded, not replaced by a symmetric score.
Default autojunk can suppress popular characters and miss near-clones; results are for this exact algorithm.
Cluster overlap shows shared clone context, not a measured causal inflation of F1.
